question: In an equilateral triangle, the circumcenter coincides with which of the following?

options.text: The midpoint of one of its sides

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an equilateral triangle, due to perfect symmetry, the medians, altitudes, angle bisectors, and perpendicular bisectors are all identical line segments.

Consequently, all the primary centers of the triangle — Centroid, Circumcenter, Incenter, and Orthocenter — coincide at exactly the same point.

Thus, the circumcenter corresponds directly to the centroid.

**∴ The correct answer is the centroid of the triangle.**
